title: Quebec French for Beginners: A Complete Guide to Understanding Modern Québécois French
description: Quebec French for Beginners is a practical, modern guide to the French that's actually spoken in Quebec today. It is not a simple list of words to learn, but a complete tour of the French language as spoken in Quebec. Without understanding Quebec, you can't understand Quebec French, and this book finally puts the language in its cultural context. Special attention has been given to explaining modern Quebec French — not outdated expressions from 75 years ago. This book takes you inside the language as it's really spoken, with its unique pronunciation, vocabulary, expressions, and grammar. Whether you're planning a trip to Montreal, moving to Quebec, married to a Québécois, or simply curious about this fascinating corner of the French-speaking world, this book will give you the tools to finally understand what Quebecers are actually saying. This book includes: * A clear breakdown of Quebec pronunciation. * Essential vocabulary, expressions, and slang used in everyday life. * An compete guide to sacres — Quebec's unique sacred profanities. * Real dialogue excerpts from Quebec films, decoded line by line. * A guide to what's current and what's outdated in Quebec slang.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_0"]', '#CardInstanceB-dYqC9zhmd2TdSQUNc1ng')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_0',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_styl

description: QUEBEC FRENCH MADE EASY FOR BEGINNERS Understand the Québec French you hear in real life—from pronunciation and everyday expressions to slang, sacres, and natural conversation. Knowing standard French doesn't always mean you'll understand a conversation in Québec. Local pronunciation, informal speech, unfamiliar expressions, connected speech, and regional vocabulary can make everyday conversations surprisingly difficult to follow. QUEBEC FRENCH MADE EASY FOR BEGINNERS is a practical guide designed to help you understand these differences and become more comfortable with modern Québécois French. Inside, you'll move from the foundations of Québec French to the language you'll encounter in everyday situations. title: Quebec French For Beginners: The Illustrated Québécois Slang Dictionary, Study Guide and P
description: You studied French. Then you heard Quebec. You learned je suis and tu es. Then a neighbour said "chu pas sûr, tsé" and the conversation moved on without you. Welcome to Quebec French, the French of the corner store (the dépanneur), the winter forecast, the group chat and the family dinner. It does not always sound like the textbook. Quebec French For Beginners is the all-in-one guide for English speakers: a slang dictionary, a study guide and a practice test workbook in one book. It is for readers who want to understand what people really say, and to know what is safe to say back. Hear it before you say it. Words and phrases come with a sound spelling written for English speakers, so you can read "tsü vyeh(n) tsü" and know how tu viens-tu? is spoken. Chapter 2 gives you the full key. Know how it lands. Each of the 634 dictionary entries carries a formality label (FORMAL, NEUTRAL, CASUAL, SLANG or VULGAR) and a freshness label (COMMON, MIXED or DATED), plus an example sentence with its English translation. You see at a glance whether a word suits your boss, your friends or neither. Practise it, and check yourself. Read a chapter, try its quiz, then test your progress with three mini-tests and a 50-question final test. Every answer is in the key. title: Quebec French: An Introductory Language Course In Québécois French As Spoken In Canada
description: All French dialects are not the same. The French dialect of Canada has evolved independently for well over a century leading to differences pronunciations, sentence construction and even some work usage. Of course the culture can be quite different too. This introductory guide covers French usage in Quebec to prepare you for a trip to the region for business or pleasure or simply to further your understanding of French usage and its different dialects. In addition to explanation of the mechanics and usage of the French dialect of Quebec the text contains side-by-side translations of key words and phrases in English and French based on frequently used words and phrases that can be easily put to use. description: Looking to dive into the vibrant, colorful, and often hilarious world of Quebec French ? The Quebec Slang Dictionary is your ultimate guide to mastering the expressions, idioms, and quirks that make the language of Quebec both unique and unforgettable. Whether you're a curious traveler, a new resident, or simply trying to decode the baffling words and phrases of your Quebecois friends , this book is packed with over 500 slang terms you'll hear on the streets, in the bars, and at the kitchen table. From the everyday expressions to the cheeky expletives, this dictionary provides clear explanations, funny examples, and English translations so you can sound like a true local in no time. So buckle up, practice your accent, and prepare to laugh your way through some of the most fun and lively phrases Quebec has to offer.
